basic_details.job_title: JIPMER Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 3 Technical Assistant, QC Manager and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Three contract posts, one each of Technical Assistant, QC Manager and Project Technical Support - III (MSW), are open in externally funded research projects of the Department of Preventive and Social Medicine at the Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER), Puducherry, under Advertisement No. JIP/PSM/INDO-USTB/NP/2026/133 dated 20-11-2026. The consolidated remuneration is Rs. 22,500, Rs 36,580 and Rs 32,480 per month respectively, with no other allowances. The essential qualification ranges from a Bachelor's degree in any discipline to a Postgraduate degree

age_limit.details: The maximum age limit for each of the three posts is 35 years, counted as on the last date of receipt of applications. Age relaxation may be granted to deserving candidates having experience of working in Government-funded research projects.

qualification.details: Qualification and experience should be in a relevant discipline/field and in a reputed institution/organization. The experience should have been gained after acquiring the essential qualification. Qualification, experience, other terms and conditions may be relaxed/altered at the discretion of the Principal Investigator. A valid email ID and mobile number are compulsory. | Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

how_to_apply: Fill the application form in the prescribed format that is attached to the advertisement. Applications not in the prescribed format will not be processed or accepted.
Scan the filled form along with your CV and supporting documents into one PDF.
Name the PDF file as "Candidate name_Post-name_year_application" (the notice's example: "James_DEO_2023_application").
Write the name of the post applied for in the email subject line.
Email the PDF to [email protected] so that it is sent by 30/11/2026, 4.30 pm.
To apply for two or more posts, fill a separate application form for each post and send each, with its enclosures, in a separate email.
important_instructions: Submission of wrong or false information at any stage of selection, or canvassing of any kind, will lead to disqualification, or even termination if detected after the person has been engaged. Each application must be for one post only; separate forms and separate emails are needed for more than one post. The list of eligible candidates will be displayed on the JIPMER website.

content_sections.heading: About JIPMER
content_sections.text: The Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER) is a medical education and research institute at Dhanwantri Nagar, Puducherry-6. These posts are in research projects led by Principal Investigator Dr Sonali Sarkar, Professor in the Department of Preventive and Social Medicine, and are funded by external agencies.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Experience in administrative support, data entry, or project coordination. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and Google Workspace. Postgraduate degree in the relevant subject/field or Public Health from a recognized university. Experience with working in Health-related Research. Experience working with REDCap, preferred. Graduate degree in Social Work, Sociology, or a relevant discipline with 3 years of relevant work experience. Expertise in working with NTEP programmes. Proficiency in speaking, writing and reading Tamil and English. Demonstrated experience in conducting tuberculosis-related research. The maximum age limit for each of the three posts is 35 years, counted as on the last date of receipt of applications. Age relaxation may be granted to deserving candidates having experience of working in Government-funded research projects. Qualification and experience should be in a relevant discipline/field and in a reputed institution/organization. The experience should have been gained after acquiring the essential qualification. Qualification, experience, other terms and conditions may be relaxed/altered at the discretion of the Principal Investigator. A valid email ID and mobile number are compulsory. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: BE/BTech in Computer Science or B.Sc. in Statistics or Biostatistics (three-year Graduate degree) from a recognized university with three years of work experience in the relevant field
Postgraduate degree in Social Work or Sociology or any other relevant discipline from a recognized university

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: All three posts carry a consolidated remuneration, and the notice states that no other allowances are payable: Rs. 22,500 for Technical Assistant, Rs 36,580 for QC Manager and Rs 32,480 per month for Project Technical Support - III (MSW). The consolidated salary of the post may vary from time to time, and no other allowance or facility other than the consolidated salary shall be extended.

content_sections.heading: JIPMER Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Assisting in various administrative tasks. Provide administrative support for the day-to-day functioning of the project. Perform data entry, document management, and maintain electronic project records. Prepare reports, presentations, and correspondence using Microsoft Office Suite and Google Workspace applications. Ensure secure handling of research data and maintain data confidentiality. Follow data protection policies, including GDPR or applicable national/institutional data protection regulations. Coordinate with project staff for documentation, meetings, and project-related activities. Maintain project files, databases, and administrative records. Perform any other duties assigned by the principal Investigator. Proficiency in MS Office. Use of R, SPSS, Access and understanding of database management as it relates to clinical research. In depth understanding of quality control procedures and relevant legal standards. Good communication skills - work with internal and external partners in data collection, quality assurance and control. Knowledge on quality control procedures and relevant legal standards. Excellent math abilities and working knowledge of data analysis/statistical methods. Working with REDCap. Perform any other duties assigned by the principal Investigator. Consenting and enrolment of participants. Co-ordinating with junior nurse for sample collection. Filling CRF. Query management. Chest X-ray: coordination with readers. Perform any other duties assigned by the principal Investigator.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JIPMER Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Documents named in the notice: Filled application form (prescribed format) CV Supporting documents / documentary proof

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applicants will be shortlisted based on the details furnished in the application, CV and the documentary proof provided. The list of eligible candidates will also be displayed on the JIPMER website. The final selection will be based on CV, application, and written test/interview. After evaluation of the application form, the recruitment process will be: Written test Skill Test Interview If the number of shortlisted candidates is less, a direct interview will be conducted instead. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for a written test and/or interview, and the decision of the Project Investigator will be final. If the number of applications is very large, more stringent criteria than those specified may be used to determine eligibility. The date of interview is 03/12/2026; the notice does not mention the interview venue or reporting time.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in JIPMER Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: one each of Technical Assistant, QC Manager and Project Technical Support - III (MSW).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Complete applications must be sent by email by 30 November 2026, 4.30 pm.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed?
faq.answer: Technical Assistant needs a Bachelor's degree in any discipline; QC Manager needs BE/BTech in Computer Science or B.Sc. in Statistics or Biostatistics with three years of relevant work experience; Project Technical Support - III (MSW) needs a Postgraduate degree in Social Work or Sociology or any other relevant discipline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 35 years for all three posts, as on the last date of receipt of applications. Age relaxation may be granted to deserving candidates with experience in Government-funded research projects.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for these posts?
faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration is Rs. 22,500 for Technical Assistant, Rs 36,580 for QC Manager and Rs 32,480 per month for Project Technical Support - III (MSW); no other allowances are payable.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Email the filled application form, CV and supporting documents, scanned in one PDF named "Candidate name_Post-name_year_application", to [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. What should be written in the email subject line?
faq.answer: The notice asks candidates to mention the name of the post applied for in the email subject line.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates go through a written test, skill test and interview; if fewer candidates are shortlisted, a direct interview will be held instead. The interview date is 3 December 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes. A separate application form must be filled for each post and sent with the necessary enclosures in separate emails.

faq.question: Q10. Are these permanent jobs?
faq.answer: No. The positions are purely on contract basis for externally sponsored projects, last only for the project duration and give no claim to any regular post in JIPMER.
